semantics: Original English 607/A: n1..100000; n separate (a,b) rows, distinct a0..1000000 in arbitrary order, b1..1000000. An activated beacon destroys only others to its left at distance <=b; destroyed beacons never activate. The added rightmost beacon can delete any suffix, including none. Unique output is the minimum number of original beacons destroyed. Sorted prefix-survivor DP uses the last coordinate strictly below a-b; literal activation over every suffix cutoff independently checks small inputs. Attestation: https://codeforces.me/problemset/problem/607/A?locale=en.
